context: Pre-market Tuesday, July 28 — a defensive, de-risking tape into the Fed. Crypto is sliding as an AI-linked equity selloff bleeds into risk sentiment; over $600M was liquidated in 24h and total market cap slipped toward $2.2T. Sentiment is Fear (F&G 29, down from 30) with BTC dominance firm ~56.5% — money is defensive, not rotating. XRP (~$1.06) is pinned above the $1.00 floor with whales accumulating into retail capitulation; SUI has broken down to new lows (-10% on the week). Themes in play: Macro-Risk (lead), Regulatory-US, ETF & Flows, Whale & Smart Money, L1 Rotation.

insights.title: The whole week bends around 2pm Wednesday
insights.body: This is a macro week, not a coin week. The FOMC decides Wed Jul 29 (2:00 PM ET) with FedWatch at ~64% hold but a live ~35% hike tail, and Chair Warsh — inflation-focused, no forward guidance — makes the 2:30 presser tone the real driver, not the rate line. Thursday then stacks Advance GDP + Core PCE at 8:30 ET. Crypto is already de-risking (>$600M liquidated, cap toward $2.2T). The play is defensive: fade extremes with small size, carry no unhedged risk into the print, and let the level re-tests after Warsh speaks set direction.

insights.title: XRP: whales buy the fifth week of capitulation
insights.body: The XRP divergence has deepened, not resolved. Whale and shark wallets have added coins for a fifth straight week while micro-wallets dump (CoinDesk Jul 23), yet spot sits at ~$1.06, below the EMA20 (~$1.11) and EMA50 (~$1.14) with a flatlined MACD and no internal catalyst. Accumulation is building a floor; it does not break resistance by itself. The lean is long-from-$1.00-defense, but only after a sweep-and-reclaim — and the whole trade is hostage to Warsh on Wednesday.

insights.title: CLARITY is running out of runway, and the market knows
insights.body: The merged CLARITY draft dropped Jul 22 and XRP holders were told they'd know by Jul 23 — it's now Jul 28 with still no floor vote scheduled, ~51 'likely yes' against a 60 threshold and only ~2 of the needed 7-9 Democrats secured, and the Senate days from recess. This is decaying from 'imminent catalyst' to 'shelved-risk.' A surprise floor-vote scheduling is the upside gap for XRP; the base case is the window closes quietly and the catalyst rolls to the fall.

insights.title: SUI is the break the others haven't made yet

That makes it the tell: if SUI can't reclaim $0.71 on any post-FOMC relief bounce, the altcoin complex hasn't bottomed. Don't catch it before a reclaim.

insights.title: Fear, not Extreme Fear — and no reclaim
insights.body: F&G at 29 (down from 30) is Fear, not capitulation, and it's falling as BTC leaks toward $63k with dominance rising — classic defensive consolidation, not a wash-out low. There's no swing-clock + volume + divergence confluence to call a bottom. Buying 'oversold' the day before a hawkish-tail FOMC is the trap; wait for a reclaim of a broken level (BTC $65k, SOL $76, XRP $1.11, SUI $0.71) with the Fed behind you.

Implication: the base case has shifted to 'catalyst shelved to the fall' — an upside surprise only if scheduled, and the odds are decaying.

AI-equity spillover (cross-asset): the crypto slide is driven by a selloff in AI-linked stocks hitting broad risk sentiment, not a crypto-native catalyst. Implication: watch the Nasdaq/AI names as the real risk tell into the Fed — crypto is trading as high-beta risk, not on its own flows.

Leverage flush (derivatives): >$600M in crypto positions were liquidated in 24h into the FOMC as traders cut leverage. Implication: forced-selling fuel is being wrung out pre-event, but it signals no one wants to hold risk into Wednesday — thin, gappy liquidity.
